start_text:
👋 *Trendyol Price Tracker*

I track Trendyol prices and tell you when a product drops or reaches your target price.

*First step:*
1. Tap “➕ Add product” or just send a product link.
2. I will check the price and add it to “📦 My products”.
3. Then you can choose the mode: discounts only or hourly checks.

If you are still looking for ideas, open “🔥 Trends”.

help_text:
❓ Help

Main action: send a Trendyol product link, and the bot will add it to tracking.

Bottom buttons:
• ➕ Add product - shows the add-product prompt
• 📦 My products - list and settings
• 🔥 Trends - shopping ideas
• 🎯 Recommendations - bot picks

Commands: /mysubs, /settings, /report
Details: /help full
help_full:
📚 Detailed help

Adding a product:
1. Open a product page on Trendyol.
2. Copy the link and send it to the bot.
3. The bot will check the price and add it to “My products”.

Notifications:
• Discounts only - message arrives when the price drops.
• Hourly - the bot sends the current price on schedule.
• Target price - a separate alert when the product reaches your price.

Management:
• /mysubs - product list
• /history NUMBER - price history
• /unsubscribe NUMBER - remove a product
• /settings - settings
• /language - language
• /report - contact admin

settings_usage:
Command for notification settings:
/settings quiet <start> <end> — configure quiet hours (0-23)
/settings price <product number> min:<price> max:<price> percent:<percent> — configure price alerts
/settings interval <product number> <minutes> — notification interval (min 15 minutes)
quiet_hours_usage:
Usage: /settings quiet <start> <end>
Example: /settings quiet 23 7 — quiet hours from 23:00 to 7:00
price_alerts_usage:
Usage: /settings price <product number> min:<price> max:<price> percent:<percent>
Example: /settings price 1 min:100 max:500 percent:10
interval_usage:
Usage: /settings interval <product number> <minutes>
Example: /settings interval 1 60 — notifications every hour

admin_commands:
📋 *Admin commands:*

`/admin stats` - user and subscription statistics
`/admin broadcast <message>` - broadcast to all users
`/admin users` - list of active users
`/admin recommend` - manage recommended products
`/admin cleanup` - cleanup old/inactive data
`/admin backup` - manual database backup
